_comment: Storage-shaped field-level exemption registry for bin/check_contract_casing.py (Decision 18, record c53289ef; adopts option (a) as a FIELD-LEVEL registry, explicitly NOT a blanket family exemption). A snake_case field in typespec/v1 is exempt ONLY if declared here with the storage location whose name the wire field is required to mirror (DB column or jsonb key; the database is canonical per Tier-1 doctrine). Any undeclared snake_case field — inside or outside the CDLC family — remains a ratchet violation. Additions are governed by Decision 13 condition 2: cite the PR that introduced the field and the storage location; no silent growth. Derived read-model aggregates (report_count, finding_count, generated_at, ...) are NOT exempt: they are computed on read and no storage key requires their spelling. Endgame: if a family later splits wire/adapter, its entries are removed and the field converts to camelCase (option (b)); the registry shrinking to zero is the --strict target.

execution_id.note: CDLC A2a execution identity; wire mirrors the DDL column (also the A2b census jsonb key metadata.census.execution_id read by exact key in keychain-snapshot.service.ts)

session_id.note: Named text reference (DBA condition 2/3), not the vision.sessions uuid concept; wire mirrors the column

census_id.note: Tier-1/Tier-2 join key; also the A2b jsonb key metadata.census.census_id (exact-key read)

source_namespace.note: Named source_namespace rather than `namespace` (reserved TypeSpec keyword); matches the doctrine transition record convention

doctrine_snapshot_id.note: B1/B3 provenance column; also the A2b jsonb key metadata.frame.doctrine_snapshot_id (exact-key read)

schema_version.note: CDLC A2b census envelope jsonb key (CENSUS_SCHEMA_VERSION pinned at write, validated on read)

procedure_card_hash.note: A2b finding-card jsonb key (content-addressed card identity)
